system/sh.brew.nginx = {
	active count = 1
	path = /Library/LaunchDaemons/sh.brew.nginx.plist
	type = LaunchDaemon
	state = running

	program = /opt/homebrew/opt/nginx/bin/nginx
	arguments = {
		/opt/homebrew/opt/nginx/bin/nginx
		-g
		daemon off;
	}

	working directory = /opt/homebrew

	default environment = {
		PATH => /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
	}

	domain = system
	minimum runtime = 10
	base minimum runtime = 10
	exit timeout = 5
	runatload = 1
	pid = 1100
}
